verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Klaviyo's API authentication, SDKs, MCP server, and rate-limit headers, but nothing describes bulk/batch endpoints (e.g., bulk profile import, bulk job APIs) or any AI-native workflow for operating across many items at once. Missing for 10: any mention of bulk/batch API endpoints, job-based bulk operations, or AI-agent tooling that operates on multiple records simultaneously.
